head: codex/22-pinned-ruby-builder-runtime
title: fix(builder): include pinned Ruby runtime
body:
## Summary

- install Ruby 3.3.6 from the checksum-pinned official source archive in the immutable builder image
- record Ruby in builder provenance
- execute a minimal Ruby program and repository validator self-test during builder preflight
- fail before the requested validation command when Ruby proof is missing

## Validation

- `TMPDIR=/Volumes/FastWork/tmp bash adl/tools/test_adl_builder_image.sh`
- `TMPDIR=/Volumes/FastWork/tmp bash adl/tools/test_run_aws_spot_builder_image_validation.sh`
- `git diff --check`
- independent exact-head review: PASS at `eba54de5b31ba52c3b34f9df455e9b9caf970378`; later commit records lifecycle review truth only

Closes #22
